notes: Names printed without a suffix (SCHOTT, STRAIGHT, COOK, VALLEY, ALFRED) are written with 'Street'. Marshall runs along the top edge and only its south line is drawn (y~188-272, rising to the west); with the printed 60' its centreline is at the paper edge, so Marshall points are computed from the south line plus 182 px: Schott/Marshall (y~7) is only ~5 px inside the paper edge and Colerain/Marshall (y~86) ~24 px inside; Spring Grove/Marshall (computed ~1855,43, paper edge ~50) and Valley/Marshall (centre beyond the binding fold) are off the sheet and not recorded. Valley is at the left edge against the binding with a R.R. siding in it; its west line is at or just past the left edge of the scan (x~0, placed by the 2701/2601 address numbers of the block west of Valley, which sit just east of that line on 253), so its centre (x~160 at Straight, ~165 at Alfred) is the midpoint between x~0 and the east line (x~318-324), nudged toward the siding (rails at x~141-180); uncertain by ~15-20 px; the page is also warped at the top-left corner (Valley's east line runs from x~110 at y 220 to ~318 at y 3500). Alfred and Cook's south ends: only the north lines of Alfred are on the paper (y~7462-7478); Alfred is 60' here, so its centre (~7645-7662) is computed. Alfred at Valley is the 60' piece (T; the 30' piece west of Valley is offset north, see 246/253). Cook (north of Alfred) runs from Straight (T, north side of Straight continuous) SSE to Alfred and jogs ~50 px east at Alfred (see 247), so it is named 'Cook Street (north of Alfred)' and its Alfred point is a T. Colerain/Straight is not recorded: only Colerain's west line reaches Straight (x~6206 at the north line) and its centre (~6458) falls at or beyond the right paper edge (~6430). Schott runs from Marshall to its dead end (an enclosed passage bridge crosses it at y~1640). Circled figures are grade elevations. No alleys.
